```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8"))  # else cat() writes non-ASCII as <U+2010> under the C locale
library(dplyr); library(readr); library(knitr); library(here); library(stringr)
rd <- \(f) read_csv(here("data", "processed", f), show_col_types = FALSE)
engines <- rd("engines.csv") |> arrange(engine_name)
people  <- rd("people_roles_evidence.csv") |> filter(in_team)
wp      <- rd("works_people.csv") |> left_join(rd("works_details.csv"), by = "work_id")
slug <- \(x) str_replace_all(str_to_lower(x), "[^a-z0-9]+", "-")
esc  <- htmltools::htmlEscape
ascii <- \(x) str_to_lower(stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII"))
# APA author list (up to 20 names; beyond that the first 19, "...", the last), with the team member
# in bold: matched by OpenAlex id `oa`, or by last name (`last`, accents ignored) where OpenAlex has
# since changed the author id. A team member hidden by the "..." is shown inside it.
apa_authors_bold <- function(names, ids, oa, last) {
  if (is.na(names) || names == "") return(NA_character_)
  raw <- str_split_1(names, "; "); id <- str_split_1(ids, "; ")
  me  <- id == oa
  if (!any(me)) me <- ascii(str_remove(raw, ",.*$")) == ascii(last)
  nm <- esc(raw)
  nm[me] <- paste0("<b>", nm[me], "</b>")
  n <- length(nm)
  if (n == 1) return(nm)
  if (n > 20) {
    hidden <- which(me & seq_len(n) > 19 & seq_len(n) < n)[1]  # keep the team member visible
    mid <- if (is.na(hidden)) ", ... " else paste0(", ... ", nm[hidden], ", ... ")
    return(paste0(paste(nm[1:19], collapse = ", "), mid, nm[n]))
  }
  paste0(paste(nm[-n], collapse = ", "), ", &amp; ", nm[n])
}
# APA-style reference: Authors (Year). Title. *Venue*.
apa_ref <- function(w, oa, name) {
  title <- str_squish(coalesce(w$title, "[untitled]"))
  title <- if_else(str_detect(title, "[.?!]$"), title, paste0(title, "."))
  last  <- word(str_squish(name), -1)
  authors <- mapply(apa_authors_bold, w$author_names, w$author_ids,
                    MoreArgs = list(oa = oa, last = last), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  paste0(if_else(is.na(authors), "", paste0(authors, " ")),
         "(", w$year, "). ", esc(title),
         if_else(is.na(w$venue), "", paste0(" <i>", esc(str_remove(w$venue, "\\.$")), "</i>.")))
}
```

OpenAlex works of Engine team members, published since the start of each Engine's search window
(five years before the award). Only people with a reliable OpenAlex author match are included: the name
and the person's current organisation both match, and the profile is not flagged as merging namesakes.
Choose an Engine, then click a name to open the list.

## Engines {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r engines, results = "asis"}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(engines))) {
  e  <- engines$engine_name[i]
  we <- wp |> filter(engine_name == e)
  pe <- people |> filter(engine_name == e, person_id %in% we$person_id) |>
    left_join(count(we, person_id, name = "n"), by = "person_id") |> arrange(desc(n))
  cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", e))
  cat(sprintf("[%s Engine page](%s.html). Window start: %s. ", e, slug(e),
              format(as.Date(engines$window_from[i]), "%B %Y")))
  if (nrow(pe) == 0) {
    cat("No team member has a reliable OpenAlex match with works since the window start.\n\n")
    next
  }
  cat(sprintf("%d team members, %d works (%d distinct; %d distinct in Engine topics).\n\n", nrow(pe), nrow(we), n_distinct(we$work_id), n_distinct(we$work_id[we$in_engine_topics %in% TRUE])))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(pe))) {
    w <- we |> filter(person_id == pe$person_id[j]) |> arrange(desc(year), desc(cited_by))
    tab <- tibble(Reference = apa_ref(w, pe$oa_id[j], pe$name[j]),
                  Type = w$type, Citations = w$cited_by,
                  `In Engine topics` = if_else(w$in_engine_topics, "yes", ""))
    # Organisation from the Engine site; if that names the Engine itself (or is missing),
    # the person's current institution in OpenAlex (a university if there is one)
    org <- str_remove(coalesce(pe$org_site[j], ""), "\\s*\\(implied\\)$")
    is_engine <- org == "" || org == e || coalesce(pe$org_type[j], "") == "engine" ||
      str_detect(org, regex("\\bengine\\b|\\bconsortium\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
    if (is_engine && !is.na(pe$last_inst[j])) {
      inst <- str_split_1(pe$last_inst[j], ";\\s*")
      univ <- str_detect(inst, "University") & !str_detect(inst, "Hospital|Medical Center")
      org  <- c(inst[univ], inst[!univ])[1]  # a university first
    }
    cat(sprintf('<details id="works-%s"><summary><b>%s</b>%s: %d %s (%d in Engine topics)</summary>\n\n',
                pe$person_id[j], htmltools::htmlEscape(pe$name[j]),
                if (nzchar(org)) paste0(", ", htmltools::htmlEscape(org)) else "", nrow(w),
                if (nrow(w) == 1) "work" else "works", sum(w$in_engine_topics, na.rm = TRUE)))
    print(kable(tab, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"'))
    cat("\n</details>\n\n")
  }
}
```

<script>
// A link like publications.html#works-<person_id> opens that Engine's tab and that person's list
// (run after rmarkdown has built the tabs, and again when only the #hash changes)
function openWorksFromHash() {
  if (location.hash.indexOf("#works-") !== 0) return;
  var d = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
  if (!d) return;
  var pane = $(d).closest(".tab-pane");
  if (pane.length) $('a[href="#' + pane.attr("id") + '"]').tab("show");
  d.open = true;
  setTimeout(function () { d.scrollIntoView(); }, 50);
}
window.addEventListener("load", function () { setTimeout(openWorksFromHash, 0); });
window.addEventListener("hashchange", openWorksFromHash);
</script>
